scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm setup:api && pnpm bootstrap
scripts.bootstrap: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/dev_bootstrap.py
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "pnpm build:api" "pnpm build:web"
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check app tests scripts && uv run ruff format --check app tests scripts && uv run lint-imports
scripts.format:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format app tests scripts && uv run ruff check --fix app tests scripts
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/pyright_gate.py --run app/domain
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/unit --cov=app --cov-report=term-missing --cov-fail-under=60
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm contracts:check
